title: Copperline Handyman & Remodel | Sample Trade Website
description: A sample website for a local handyman and remodeling business: before and after, services, reviews and a free-estimate request. A concept by Tava Valenti.
sample_notice: This is a sample website for a made-up handyman and remodeling business, to show what a local business site can look like. Photos are AI-generated placeholders.
name: Copperline Handyman & Remodel

hero.alt: A bright renovated kitchen with white cabinets, open shelves and pendant lights
hero.sub: Repairs, installs and small remodels for homes across North County San Diego. One call, an on-time crew and a clear price up front.

before_after.text: A tired 1980s hall bath in Carlsbad, taken down to the studs and rebuilt with a walk-in shower and new vanity. Drag the line to compare.
before_after.aria: Before and after of a bathroom: a dated oak vanity and tub-shower on the left, a white vanity and glass walk-in shower on the right. Drag to compare.

services_head.text: No job is too small. Save up your list, or call us for one thing, and we'll handle it right.

services.alt: A remodeled bathroom with a glass shower
services.title: Bathroom remodels
services.text: New showers, vanities, tile and fixtures, from a quick refresh to a full rebuild.

services.alt: A renovated kitchen with white cabinets
services.title: Kitchen updates
services.text: Backsplashes, shelves, lighting and hardware that make an older kitchen feel new.

services.title: Drywall & repairs
services.text: Holes, cracks and water damage patched so you can't tell where they were.

services.alt: A handyman fitting a new interior door with a level
services.title: Doors & trim
services.text: Sticking doors fixed, new doors hung, and baseboards and trim installed.

services.alt: A refinished wood deck with new railings
services.title: Decks & fences
services.text: Loose boards, wobbly rails and broken gates repaired or rebuilt.

services.alt: A mounted TV with floating shelves
services.title: Mounting & installs
services.text: TVs, shelves, fans, fixtures and faucets, installed level and secure.

steps.text: No pressure and no surprise charges. You'll know the price and the arrival window before we come.

items.title: Call or send your list
items.text: Tell us what needs doing. Photos of each item help us price it quickly.

items.title: Clear, written price
items.text: Small jobs get a price over the phone. Bigger projects get a free visit and a written estimate.

items.title: Done right, cleaned up
items.text: We show up in the window we promised, finish the list and leave the place clean.

items.quote: I had a list of 11 things I'd been putting off for years. They finished it all in one day and cleaned up after.
items.name: Barbara W.

items.quote: Our bathroom remodel came in on budget and on schedule. They explained every step and never left a mess.
items.name: Dan & Ellen P.

items.quote: Showed up exactly when they said. Fair price, friendly, and the door finally closes properly.
items.name: Joe M.

about.alt: Hands installing a new kitchen faucet
about.text: Copperline is a small, owner-run company in Carlsbad. The owner prices every job and does much of the work, so you always know who's in your home.

estimate.text: Send a few details and we'll call you back within one business day.
estimate.placeholder: List the jobs, and anything we should know about access or timing...
